about.title: About
about.description: Institutional context of Algarve Paradise Media.
about.historyP1: Algarve Paradise Media was created with the aim of giving a voice to the Algarve region, building a bridge between the community, institutions and relevant information.
about.historyP2: The project responds to the need to modernize regional communication with a more accessible, dynamic and people-centred format, without losing institutional rigour.
about.pillar1Desc: Digital structure designed for news, useful information and the regional agenda.
about.pillar2Desc: The community participates, engages and finds a space for representation.
about.pillar3Desc: The tone and visual structure were designed to engage with local entities.

about.mvvDesc: The blocks below define the editorial and institutional framework of the association.
about.foundersTitle: Founding team with professional and institutional background
about.foundersDesc: The portraits and descriptions are ready to receive real photographs and final information.
about.storyTitle: A platform created to give voice to the Algarve
about.storyDesc: Algarve TV Paradise is a digital platform created to give voice to the Algarve region. In a context where local information is often limited or scattered, this project brings together, organises and shares relevant content in a simple and accessible way.
